items: Early today, the sun is bright.
Soon, clouds come into the sky.
By noon, the weather gets warm.
This afternoon, the wind blows hard.
A little later, rain starts to fall.
Toward evening, the air gets cool.
As it gets dark, they return inside.
On a sunny morning, birds sing.
During a hot day, kids drink water.
On a cold evening, people wear coats.
